name: Sanemi Shinazugawa
portrait: chars/tier/7/C High/Demon Slayer - Kimetsu No Yaiba/Sanemi/1.webp
banner: chars/tier/7/C High/Demon Slayer - Kimetsu No Yaiba/Sanemi/2.webp
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Wind Hashira
summary: Sanemi Shinazugawa is the Wind Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. After awakening his Demon Slayer Mark, his already exceptional physical abilities were amplified dramatically, allowing him to contend with some of the strongest demons in existence and fight alongside other marked Hashira.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: The Demon Slayer Mark increases Sanemi's strength and speed by an order of magnitude. He was able to split Muzan in half and withstand attacks from Kokushibo. His performance could increase further through Near-Death Amp and a Bright Red Nichirin Sword, but those are not treated as separate variants here.
